scripts.release:react: pnpm --filter @timui/react run build && pnpm --filter @timui/react publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:vue: pnpm --filter @timui/vue run build && pnpm --filter @timui/vue publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:html: pnpm --filter @timui/html run build && pnpm --filter @timui/html publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:weapp: pnpm --filter @timui/weapp run build && pnpm --filter @timui/weapp publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.registry:typecheck:vue: pnpm --filter @timui/vue run typecheck && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/docs/tsconfig.vue-registry-ts.json && node --import tsx scripts/check-vue-registry-sfc.ts
scripts.cli:e2e:add: pnpm --filter @timui/cli run build && node --import tsx scripts/cli-e2e-add-button.ts
scripts.goal:lint: pnpm --filter @timui/core run lint && pnpm --filter @timui/react run lint && pnpm --filter @timui/vue run lint && pnpm --filter @timui/weapp run lint && pnpm --filter @timui/cli run lint && pnpm --filter @timui/tokens run lint && pnpm --filter @timui/docs run lint
scripts.goal:typecheck: pnpm --filter @timui/react run typecheck && pnpm --filter @timui/vue run typecheck
scripts.goal:multi-build: pnpm --filter @timui/weapp run build && pnpm --filter @timui/html run build
scripts.goal:acceptance: pnpm goal:gap && pnpm goal:consistency && pnpm goal:perf
scripts.goal:acceptance:strict: pnpm goal:acceptance && pnpm goal:typecheck && pnpm goal:multi-build
scripts.goal:ci:fast: pnpm goal:acceptance:strict && pnpm goal:lint && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm --filter @timui/core run build && pnpm packages:build
